احتبسا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَبَسَا (iḥtabasā) /iħ.ta.ba.saː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اُحْتُبِسَا (uḥtubisā) /uħ.tu.bi.saː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اِحْتَبِسَا (iḥtabisā) /iħ.ta.bi.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
